body: 新增 2 則文獻：UK Biobank 巢式病例對照研究（Mov Disord，114 例新發 MSA；居住鄉村為唯一隨潛伏期增強的暴露，5 年窗 OR 2.73）與因斯布魯克團隊領域綜論（J Neural Transm，指出 α-synuclein 標的治療迄今未展現一致臨床效益）。更新 Alterity ATH434 一列：2026/07/07 FDA End-of-Phase-2 會議紀錄確認註冊路徑（Ph3 約 200 人、主要終點 11 項 UMSARS Part I、單一樞紐試驗＋確認性證據），並加入領域焦點一則。CT.gov 近 7 天 MSA 適應症逐筆確認後無新療法試驗（其餘命中為肌少症、PSP 遠距監測等非 MSA 療法研究）。

en.body: Added 2 papers: a UK Biobank nested case-control study (Mov Disord; 114 incident MSA cases, with rural living the only exposure that strengthened with latency, 5-year OR 2.73) and a field review from the Innsbruck group (J Neural Transm, noting that α-synuclein-targeted therapies have not yet shown consistent clinical benefit). Updated the Alterity ATH434 row: FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting minutes announced 2026/07/07 confirmed the registrational pathway (Ph3 of ~200 patients, 11-item UMSARS Part I primary endpoint, single pivotal trial plus confirmatory evidence), and added a matching field-focus item. A study-by-study check of the last 7 days on CT.gov found no new MSA therapy trials (other hits were sarcopenia, PSP remote monitoring and similar non-MSA studies).

body: 新增 1 篇文獻（Cell：TPPP/p25 類澱粉種子活性作為 MSA 專一性生物標記）。CT.gov 掃描未見在研療法新進者——新登錄的 Synusight SST001（NCT07604116）為 PET 造影示蹤劑、非治療藥物，依準則不收錄。

en.body: Added 1 paper (Cell: TPPP/p25 amyloid seeding activity as a specific biomarker for MSA). The CT.gov sweep surfaced no new investigational therapy — the newly registered Synusight SST001 (NCT07604116) is a PET imaging tracer, not a therapeutic, and is excluded per the inclusion criteria.

body: 新增 2 篇文獻（QSM 黑質磁化率／體積比之 PSP/PD/MSA 鑑別、MSA 不隨意吸氣性歎息與腦血流研究）。

en.body: Added 2 papers (QSM substantia-nigra susceptibility-to-volume ratio for PSP/PD/MSA discrimination, and involuntary inspiratory sighing with cerebral blood flow in MSA).

body: MSA-IQ 情報站上線：收錄 11 個在研療法／學術案、8 個臨床試驗、9 筆試驗讀出、4 項評估量表、3 個自然史世代、3 則機轉與臨床前重點、9 篇近期文獻，全部附可查證來源、中英雙語。

en.body: MSA-IQ went live: 11 therapies and academic programmes, 8 clinical trials, 9 trial readouts, 4 rating scales, 3 natural-history cohorts, 3 mechanism/preclinical topics and 9 recent papers — every entry sourced, in both Chinese and English.
